name: workstream
description: Workstream repository: skills, context, processes and knowledge.

entries.name: code-in-english
entries.description: Everything that lives in the codebase is written in English (code, identifiers, comments, tests, commit messages, branch names, pull requests), while the conversation with the user and Workstream documents stay in the user's language. Use when writing or changing code, tests or comments, committing, naming a branch, or opening a pull request.

entries.name: no-ai-signatures
entries.description: Keep commits free of AI agent signatures (Co-Authored-By Claude/Anthropic, "Generated with Claude Code"). Use when committing, opening a pull request, or setting up a repository whose owner does not want agent attribution.

entries.name: preferences
entries.description: Starting point for how agents should work in a Workstream project: language, updates, work tracking, checks, permissions, restarts

entries.name: creative-production
entries.description: Brief and references, the right model, job receipts, review at full size, smallest useful revision

entries.name: workspace-authoring
entries.description: Reuse or create a Workspace card, write the report with the shared styling, then test it at wide and narrow widths

entries.name: video-watch
entries.description: Use the local extractor for a timestamped visual overview of a video clip

entries.name: models-3d
entries.description: The project's 3D models (glTF, GLB, OBJ, STL), previewed by Workstream: orbit camera, animations.
